d: We are seeking an experienced Project Manager (Project / Programme Manager) to join a national eHealth programme.

Plan and control eHealth projects through the full lifecycle, ensuring that scope, schedule, budget, quality, resources, risks, stakeholders and operational readiness are managed using recognised project-management methods.
q: Bachelor’s degree in a clinical or paramedical discipline.
Minimum of 7 years in a relevant role, including at least 3 years in project management.
Healthcare technology project-management experience across clinical systems or national digital-health solutions.
Experience managing plans, WBS, resources, schedules, budgets, risks, issues, dependencies, vendors and reporting.
Working knowledge of recognised methodologies such as PMP/PMBOK, PRINCE2, Agile or hybrid delivery.
Integrated project plans, WBS, milestones and critical path
Scope, budget, resource and commercial controls
RAID management, change control, dependencies and escalation
Steering committees, dashboards, minutes, decisions and action tracking
Vendor, healthcare-provider and multidisciplinary stakeholder management
Testing, cutover, go-live, hypercare and service transition
Benefits realisation, acceptance, closure and lessons learned
Delivery of national HIE, EMR/HIS, e-prescription or health-insurance platforms
Experience working within a programme or project management office (PMO)
Experience managing multiple providers, integrators or parallel workstreams
